supersedes: studies/gate0/gate0_item1_audit.json, which was collected on the unrepaired model at bc40fb6 and stays on record rather than being re-scored
why: ADR 0007 attaches the wheel friction axes to the wheel, so every motion figure the platform has recorded moves. Gate 0 item 1 is the cheapest of the three affected artifacts and is re-collected first.

protocol.unchanged_from_the_superseded_audit: Three repeats each of qualify_detached_pod (self_mobile_pod_qualification world) and qualify_assembly_motion --expected-morphology compact_diff (motion_qualification.launch.py, indoor_doorway), all six to pass the tools' built-in criteria.
protocol.added: The gate has only ever measured one heading, which is what let a heading-dependent defect through. Four heading-varied cases are added and must pass the same built-in criteria: the assembly at imposed yaw +90, -90 and +45 degrees, and the detached pod at +90. +/-90 is where authority measured exactly zero before the repair.
protocol.pose_imposition: gz set_pose at the world's own spawn position, settled before the declared stage sequence; the spawn-heading repeats are not teleported at all.
protocol.rate: the tools' defaults, so the gate is the gate: 0.35 rad/s for the assembly and the detached tool's own 0.6 rad/s
protocol.hygiene: one simulator only; each case aborts unless the simulator process count is zero beforehand, and tears down afterwards
protocol.transport: FASTDDS_BUILTIN_TRANSPORTS=SHM, as the superseded audit used; transport only

pass_criteria: All ten runs pass their tool's built-in criteria. A heading-varied case failing would mean the repair is incomplete, not that the gate should be relaxed.

predictions_declared_before_running.expected: All ten pass, and the heading-varied cases return figures close to the spawn-heading ones, because the intervention measured rotation at 74% of command and straight travel at 0.7336 m at +/-90 with fdir1 set.
predictions_declared_before_running.what_would_be_a_finding: Any heading-varied case failing, or figures at +/-90 differing from the spawn heading by more than the run-to-run spread of the three repeats.
